entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Based on the look in your eyes, I'm[n]guessing your friends aren't going[n]to be of any use to us.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh yes, because I'm sure you're all just[n]as close as you were before reality[n]was changed.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We need as much manpower as possible[n]right now.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I was hoping at least some of them[n]would avoid being useless... But that[n]seems to be beyond their capabilities.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, there's no point in griping about[n]it out here.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: As I mentioned yesterday, it's quite[n]likely that we'll have to confront Maruki[n]physically.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If you're not prepared for such a[n]contingency, then please go and take[n]care of your affairs as quickly as possible.
